cae_papers.title: Nonparametric multiscale modeling of boundary lubrication: hexadecane in highly pressurized gold asperity contacts
cae_papers.summary_en: Boundary lubrication is governed by molecular processes at the sliding interface that are inaccessible to classical continuum descriptions. cae_papers.title: Planning a Shared Modular Fixture Layout Across Robotic Disassembly Stages
cae_papers.summary_en: Stable support remains challenging in robotic disassembly of irregularly shaped products.
